name: a percent sign is prose, not a comment
source:
Growth of 50% overall, a strong year.
The second line has five words.

name: line and nested block comments are skipped
source:
Visible words here. // hidden comment words
/* block /* nested */ still hidden */ After the comment.

name: let, set, show and import statements are code
source:
#let title = "Hidden string"
#set text(font: "Libertinus Serif", size: 11pt)
#show heading: set text(weight: "bold")
#show figure: it => block[Template words]
#import "lib.typ": template
Only this line counts.

name: headings are counted by level
source:
= Introduction
Body text one.
== Background and context
More body.
=== Deep dive
#heading(level: 2)[Called heading]

name: figures, tables and captions
source:
#figure(
  image("plot.png", width: 80%),
  caption: [Measured response of the sample],
) <fig:plot>
#figure(
  table(
    columns: 2,
    [Name], [Value],
    [Alpha], [One],
  ),
  caption: [Summary table],
) <tab:summary>
#table(columns: 2, [Loose], [cells])
See @fig:plot and @tab:summary for details.

name: citations and footnotes
source: Prior work @smith2020 and @doe2021 agrees.#footnote[See the appendix for proofs.] Also #cite(<knuth1984>) helps.

name: raw text and fenced raw blocks
source:
Use `let x = 1` inline.
```rust
fn main() { println!("hidden"); }
```
After the block.

name: content arguments, code blocks and conditionals
source:
#show: report.with(
  title: [A study of drift],
  abstract: [We measure drift.],
)
#let note(body) = block[Note text #body]
#block(width: 100%, {
  set par(justify: true)
  text(weight: "bold")[Bold title words]
  [Plain content words]
})
#if true [Shown branch] else [Other branch]
#context [Context words]
Tail.

source:

source:
